about: Messages with the chat they were sent in, and the route the routing step should give each. The routing check builds each case's routing input with the runtime's own code and asks the routing model. history holds the chat's earlier entries as the runtime receives them; the message is added after them. Nine cases were sent in a recorded local test, each with the entries its routing step received there: map-trip, comparison-page, comparison-fill-in, page-from-findings, browser-named, browser-follow-up, keep-going-open-route, browser-sign-in and browser-form. keep-going-after-stop-and-undo was not: its chat is keep-going-open-route's up to the first Undo, with the route exchange taken out, the request and reply that named the route edited to match, and that reply's offer of more cut. page-from-unconfirmed-findings and keep-going-route-open-after-stop-and-undo were sent in a later recorded local test, each with the entries its routing step received there, a path's space id replaced as in keep-going-open-route. comparison-fill-in-after-a-reply and keep-going-unconfirmed-route-after-stops-and-undo were sent in a third recorded local test, each with the entries its routing step received there, a path's space id replaced as before. page-from-findings-with-the-route-unconfirmed and keep-going-after-a-page-made-from-findings were sent in a fourth recorded local test, each with the entries its routing step received there, a path's space id replaced as before. warranty-from-each-laptops-page and keep-going-after-two-stops-and-an-undo were sent in a fifth recorded local test, each with the entries its routing step received there, a path's space id replaced as before. page-from-confirmed-findings was not sent: its chat is browser-follow-up's, with a message that asks for a page of the hours alone. map-weekend was sent in none of them, and plain-answer and rewrite-names-a-map come from the Octo turn eval's cases.
